summary: A 6x4 rigid tipper: the cab-over truck on a tandem-drive bogie with a lofted half-round steel body that TIPS… joints cab_tilt, door_l, door_r, tipper, tailgate, wheel_f_l_roll, …; options body, paint; sockets socket_driver, socket_tow, seat_driver, seat_pax_1, socket_load, exhaust_0, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.dump_truck or place "prefab": "dump_truck" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
